_comment: Config #3: the roof condition alert, intake pass 2026-08-24. Filled with what is already on disk (roof-dial RESULTS-2026-08-20.md, the UW touches census, shared weights); the funnel and post-bind counts are honestly UNPRICED until the boundary cohort is pulled (COHORT-PICKER.md names the method and the traps). The machine runs on this config today and prints chips, not guesses.

alert.name: Roof condition manual review
alert.description: Quotes whose roof model score trips the alert cannot bind until an underwriter reviews the roof. Third-largest alert family by UW touches (1,156/mo). The auto roof-surfacing-exclusion model is the live lever: today it covers 5.5% of the exclusion work UWs do on bound 101+ NB (59 of 1,077, May 1-Aug 15), and the review-lane roof job did NOT shrink after the April launch (23.9% to 26.4% of approvals).
notes: Boundary traps (data-recipes.md, roof-dial facts): 'exclude' spans scores 1-97, so the live decision is NOT a pure score cut; scores only exist on binds from April 2026 onward; model versions coexist (v1.2.0 dominant) - pin or stratify.

Aperture curve, if the auto-exclusion dial widens (RESULTS-2026-08-20.md): bar 80 = 60.7% capture at 1.10 unwanted exclusions per caught home (~195 over-applies/mo); bar 83 = 54.7% / 0.95; bar 85 = 50.7% / 0.83. Today's setting caught 0 of 106 roof-cancelled homes, including all 12 scoring 95+; Texas has 0 auto-applies since the May 11 launch.

The roof lever has the first loss number anywhere: ~83% of expected roof-peril dollars unpaid on excluded homes, ~$52 avoided paid loss per excluded home-year, hand-picked roofs only (LOSS-JOIN-2026-08-21.md, branch worktree-roof-loss-join). That prices the LEVER, not this alert.

estimator.comparison: quotes scoring just under the roof alert cutoff vs just over, April 2026 onward (the score-coverage window), model version pinned or stratified; state-matched for any removal sizing, never pooled
estimator.notes: NOT PULLED YET. The band definition and window come from COHORT-PICKER.md; the decision column is not a pure score cut, so the boundary must be built on the score, not the decision.

forced_reviews_per_month.source: UW touches census (Jan-Jun 2026): 1,156 referral reviews/mo carry the roof condition family. Multi-alert submissions count toward each family, so removal frees FEWER than all of these (some reviews survive because another alert also fires); the single-family share is the intake pull.
